messages:
alex: Heads-up — the Porch Gnome (aka 'Gnomonaut') has gone missing from the 3rd-floor snack shelf. Last seen during coffee run this morning. Anyone take him for a heroic mission? :eyes:
sam: I did move him to the breakroom windowsill at 9:12am to give him sunlight. 10:03am he was gone. suspect: hungry intern or the potted fern.
maria: not me. he left a tiny post-it that said 'optimize latency' so i'm convinced it's a product feature now. :joy:
jen: If found, please return immediately. He is on the official rota to supervise pastries.
paul: Quick poll: Should we require a signing-out sheet for all lore artifacts? :clipboard: react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
alex: also, whoever wins the gnome custodianship gets to rename one conference room. Rules set by tradition (aka me).
sam: I vote 'Gnome Custody -> Gnome Custodian' and request permanent bookshelf rights.
maria: Suggestion: attach a tiny helmet and call him 'GnomePilot' during deploys.
jen: Found a crumb trail near the copier. possible suspect footage: security cam 14:02 — can someone check?
paul: @sam you were near copier at 14:02 according to my memory. innocent until proven gnomeless.
jen: archive snippet from security-bot (not an actual subpoena): ``camera-3: 14:02 — small hat-like silhouette crosses frame``
alex: classic. Also if anyone is keeping the gnome for morale reasons we can arrange a temporary custody transfer form. totally serious.
lunch-bot: lunchtime reminder: today’s special is kimchi pancakes. also 1g of gnome ownership points per returned artifact.
maria: awarding 10 honorary 'Gnome Guardian' points to whoever brings him back. reward: bragging rights and a sticky note crown.
sam: Update: I checked under the ficus. no gnome but found 3 pens, 1 half-eaten granola, and a mysterious sticker that says 'ship it'.
paul: okay new theory: gnome staged a soft launch and shipped himself to the wild.
jen: if someone spots a tiny helmet or hears faint chanting about 'reduce p99' that's probably him.
alex: For the record, if found please place gnome in the snack shelf. He prefers hummus proximity.
paul: closing status for now — will reopen thread if sighting or crumbs increase. :detective:
jen: also taking applications for 'gnome guardian' role. must love tiny hats and puns.
maria: I nominate @sam for hero of the hour.
sam: I accept on the condition of more coffee. :coffee:
